prefixes.boundedContext: media sessions, provider management, recording metadata, quality telemetry, and RTC persistence
notes: Use rtc_ only for RTC authority-owned tables.
Do not rename unrelated IAM, Drive, IM signaling, ops, or platform tables to rtc_.
Desktop SQLite tables that materialize RTC state must use the same rtc_ logical table names.

nonRtcPrefixPolicy.description: Tables outside the RTC bounded context keep their own business-domain prefix or existing approved legacy name.
